post.text:
Ok, something awesome just happened. 

Someone genius, in France, @romainsimon (bravo), created skills for AI agents specialized in "paperasse" (= French paperwork bureaucracy).

I opened Codex, and it did all my taxes. Like for real

Even more, instead of a hellish chore, it was fun?

Triple checked everything (yeah you never know) and it was 100% correct

The bonus: with Browser Use, codex filled all the cells on the Taxes website. Surreal

You can check it out (in French) https://t.co/WBIBqu29ir

comments.name: Max | LEGEND💎
comments.text:
Are you aware that all the data that passes through GPT or Claude is processed and stored on American servers, which are frequently compromised?

By simply sharing your personal information, such as your home address, income, job, and more, you inadvertently gave away a significant amount of your privacy. 

Even a simple bank record can reveal sensitive details like your health status, habits, and whether you have children.

It’s completely absurd to trade all your most private information for a codex that will fill tiny cells for you.
